payload.reason: The evidence indicates that the model incorporates visual contexts and uses a modality attention module to improve predictions of named entities, suggesting that it inspects how image parts relate to words.

claims.text: The model uses visual contexts to improve predictions of named entities, indicating it inspects the association between image parts and words.
The modality attention module amplifies relevant visual contexts and attenuates irrelevant ones, showing that the model adapts based on the visual information available.
Error analysis shows that incorporating visual contexts affects the prediction of named entities, further supporting the inspection of learned associations.
